description: The Montage recipe: one recurring character in 8–16 independent everyday gags, cut on the beat into a 9:16 reel of about 6–11 seconds with a music bed. It runs the existing steps in order — gags (lab_situationen), stills with the character and the phone-flash look (auto-storyboard 9:16), identity check with ONE retry per deviating still, a STOP until the human accepts the stills (lab_review_asset), music, sequence, beat grid and rhythm, beat-length clips, placing them, export (social_vertical). If the export contains a synthetic PERSON or VOICE, it needs a release only a signed-in human can give: the recipe STOPS with stopp freigabe_noetig — the human exports that sequence with social_vertical in the web app and confirms the wording; the next weiter takes over that export and checks it. Each call with aktion weiter does exactly ONE step and stores the state in the project, so an interrupted run continues where it stopped; call it again until phase is fertig. MONEY: aktion preis (or get_cost) returns the expected and the maximum price per item and a recommended cap — free. Paid steps run only inside a released lab_auto_lauf (lauf_id) and the recipe checks its free amount before every paid step. The character must already have a sheet with a reference image (lab_create_character with gattung, then lab_generate_character_reference) — it is not part of the price. aktion stand shows the state, abbrechen deletes it (generated material stays).

aktion.description: preis: price per item; weiter: one step; stand: show state; abbrechen: delete the state

bpm.description: Start only: tempo written into the default music prompt (default 120)

figur_id.description: Start only: character sheet id with a reference image — positive integer as string

get_cost.description: Same as aktion preis — nothing is generated or charged

lauf_id.description: Released auto run (lab_auto_lauf) whose cap pays for the steps — required for paid steps

musik_prompt.description: Start only: music prompt; default is an instrumental groove with a steady beat

project_id.description: Project id (from lab_list_projects) — positive integer as string

situationen.description: Start only: your own gags instead of suggested ones (e.g. picked from lab_situationen)

bewegung_en.description: English motion with a strong movement verb

bild_en.description: English still prompt: one moment, one action

thema.description: Start only: theme or setting for the gags, e.g. 'big city at night'
